name: @xeplr/workflow-api
description: The free workflow HTTP API over @xeplr/workflow-engine: mount it in an Express app with registerWorkflow(), or run it on its own, and build your own workflow screens on it.

scripts.db:create: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate create-db --connectionName api --connection-env WORKFLOW_CONNECTION
scripts.migrate:up: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate up --dir ../engine/migrations --connectionName api --connection-env WORKFLOW_CONNECTION
scripts.migrate:status: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate status --dir ../engine/migrations --connectionName api --connection-env WORKFLOW_CONNECTION

author: xeplr
